description: Erection of two storey side extension with part single storey rear infill extension with the demolition of existing side extension
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [AR-R00-PR-102, AR-R00-PR-103, AR-R00-PR-104, AR-R00-PR-107, AR-R00-EX-101 
Received: 14/08/2023
AR-R02-PR-102 REV B, AR-R02-PR-103 REV B, AR-R02-PR-104 REV B,  AR-R02-PR-107 REV B, AR-R02-PR-101 REV B
Received: 23/10/2023].
Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings (including doorways) shall be formed in the side or front elevations of the development hereby permitted.

Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose ancillary to the enjoyment of the single family dwellinghouse at the 'Site Address' described at the top of this decision letter and shall not be occupied as a separate dwelling, nor used for business purposes and shall not have a separate external entrance.
